Generate a newsletter that promotes the next conference in rich text format:
{!$RecordSnapshot:Conference.Snapshot}
Use different styles to make the newsletter nicer, use different sizes and colors for titles and include emoticons.
Include information about the speakers and sponsors and also the conference logo. Don't include information about the survey or the owner.
Invite readers to join the conference, and make the description and event information more appealing.
The response must be valid rich text and not contain anything else.
